# The card pool — standing reference

*Generated by `pnpm reference` from `data/cards` — do not edit by hand. 173 cards (145 real, 28 custom; tokens excluded, the five laws included). Text is the def's `text` where authored, else the Scryfall oracle text from `data/art/real/oracle.json`. Shop tier: the ring a card first stocks in (1 civilized / 2 approach / 3 wild; R never stocks — the R drawer). Price = round(shopPriceMultiplier × shopBasePrice × (1 + mana value) × shopTierMultiplier[tier]) at default knobs (`priceOverride` where set); basics are free. `prizeOnly` cards never stock and are never staked. The pool-registry (docs/registries/pool-registry.md) carries each card's status and vocabulary words; the card-tier audit (docs/card-tier-audit-v2.md) carries the tiering rationale.*
